sentences.text:
Applicants apprehend their arrest in connection with Crime No.94/2023 registered at Police Station- Pichore, District Gwalior for the offenses punishable under Section 306,
enhanced Section 498A of IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.
The prosecution story in nutshell is that the on 01.04.2023, one Mahesh Baghel informed that her daughter committed suicide by hanging and Merg No.09/2023 was taken under investigation.
During investigation Sunita, Mother of deceased, Sister Malti, Gayatri, Father Mahesh, Brother Ashu were asked about the reason behind the death of the deceased Bhavna.
They informed that marriage of deceased was fixed with Ankesh 3 years ago and both used to talk each other.

On 27.03.2023, the family members of deceased asked the uncle of Ankesh, Ballu Baghel for the marriage of deceased Bhavna and Ankesh, he demanded for dowry of Rs.5 lakh and only on the fulfillment of demand the marriage will take place.
Family members of Ankesh also used to demand for dowry and due to these demands deceased got mentally disturbed and committed suicide on 01.04.2023.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicants that applicants are apprehending their arrest on the basis of registration of offence as above.
Confinement may bring social disrepute and personal inconvenience.
Applicants shall cooperate in the investigation/trial and he is ready to abide by the terms and conditions as imposed over them.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
P er contra, learned counsel for the respondent-State opposes the bail application and prays for dismissal of the same.
Considering the submissions made by counsel for the parties, and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, this court deems it fit to grant anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, the instant application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest,
applicants
be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required.
He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr. P. C.
